data.content_ref: inline:The problem 004c5856e33e contradicts the assumption of expert superiority by utilizing the 'baseline performance' claim in SRC_003, arguing that a high-floor baseline is more reliable than a high-variance peak. This relation is refuted if the expert's 'intuition' is proven to be a high-speed processing of the same checklist items with superior weighting, making the checklist redundant or obstructive.
